How to verify: Mark the face, edge, fence, stop, datum, and feed direction used to locate the cut.
Pass criteria: Every part in the batch uses the same controlled references.

Pass criteria: Dimension, square, orientation, edge quality, and downstream fit all pass.

How to verify: Set a recheck frequency and stop rule for drift, damage, setup movement, or label mismatch.
Pass criteria: The batch cannot continue beyond a failed check without correction and a new first article.

How to verify: Match file name, revision, units, postprocessor, sheet map, and machine to the released job traveler.
Pass criteria: The controller is loaded with the intended verified program.

How to verify: Check vacuum zones, clamps, tabs, spoilboard, tool path, fixtures, and machine travel.
Pass criteria: Nothing can move or collide throughout the full path.

How to verify: Review cut order, depths, lead-ins, tool changes, and remaining skin before using project stock.
Pass criteria: The simulated result matches geometry and a controlled first run passes inspection.
